title: DP holding upload (BOW front end, ONLY DP HOLDING)
purpose: Each client's sellable demat holdings with average price and credit-for-sale haircut, without the pool: 10 fields, one line per client per security with a DP quantity (as the combined file's DP part). BOW takes user deposit and user stock files during market hours too (other files 17:30 to 08:00).

columns.name: BackOffice ID
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The client's UCC

columns.name: NSE Symbol
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. NSE symbol (NSE security master); blank when the security has only a BSE code (as the broker's file)

columns.name: Series
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. NSE series (EQ, BE, BZ, SM, GB …); blank when the symbol is blank

columns.name: BSE Scrip  Code
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. BSE scrip code (BSE scrip file); sometimes blank

columns.name: DPQuantity
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Holding quantity from the DP: the sellable demat quantity (as Finspot's ISIN Holding)

columns.name: DPAvePrice
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The client's average price of the demat holding (Holding.AvgCost; 0.00 when unknown)

columns.name: DPCFSHaircut
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Credit-for-sale haircut % on the DP holding (10 means 90% of the sell value is available). The firm's value in Connections → BOW upload files (default 0, as the broker's file)

linked: Live RMS → Front-office files → BOW uploads (only DP holding)
source: BOW File_Formats.xlsx, sheet ONLY DP HOLDING
